Name: Inventory Indicators
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Item Categories
[/b][/size]
By default, items with categories that have a color code designated by the game will get a colored  border 4 pixels in width.

You can change the color and thickness of the border in the config.

If you set the border width to 0, the entire background will be colored.

Some item categories don't have designated colors - these are added to the config as transparent. You can edit the colors in the config to add borders / backgrounds for those item categories.


[b][size=5]Loved Items
[/size][/b]
By default, universally-loved items are indicated with a pink heart and loved items already known by the player are indicated by villager portraits.

You can disable the above, and / or enable indicating loved items that are not yet known by the player in the config.


[b][size=5]Bundle Items
[/size][/b]
By default, items that can still be submitted to community center bundles are indicated by a green junimo.

You can disable the above or change the color of the Junimo in the config.


[size=5][b]Plantable Seeds
[/b][/size]
By default, seeds that can be planted in the current season are indicated by a sprout.

You can disable the above or change the opacity of the sprout in the config.


[b][size=5]Config
[/size][/b]
This mod implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] menu for in-game config editing.

To be able to edit the colors in-game,  you must also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url].


[b][size=5]Technical
[/size][/b]
Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url]
